ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity black pixels (approx 85% of surface) to high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottled white/grey blobs located on distal margins of both lobes. Contiguous white circular rings (annular shapes) scattered across the dark central and lower field. Three distinct parallel yellow-white linear strokes on the viewer-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 50-60 degrees, with deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular sawtooth serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is highest on the distal one-third of each lobe, becoming more compressed toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular white annular scars (approx 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the central dark region of both lobes, resembling barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, parallel, diagonal linear disruptions on the viewer-left lobe, approx 30-50 pixels in length, showing high-contrast yellowish internal pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical colonization of live barnacles on the upper distal corners of both lobes; several deep irregular indentations/notches on the trailing edge of the viewer-left lobe that disrupt the linear serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of three parallel rake marks on the viewer-left lobe and a significant vertical scratch near the median notch on the viewer-right lobe.
